title: Collect NumPy chunks before concatenating
why: NumPy arrays do not grow in place, so assigning append, concatenate, vstack, or hstack back to an input array inside a loop repeatedly reallocates and copies it.
suggestion: Collect chunks in a Python list and concatenate or stack them once after the loop.
limitations: Only qualified calls through an alias established by import numpy are reported for append, concatenate, vstack, and hstack.
The assigned variable must also occur in the call arguments and have a visible assignment outside the active loop; array size, loop bounds, parameters, and hidden ownership are not inferred.
